notes.title: Roadmap Blog
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Brinehunters!

Thank you for being with us during the launch of Abyssus. We’re very happy to see so many of you enjoying the game! [/p][p][/p][p]We want to reiterate our post-launch plans:

We have a lot of post-launch content planned, and all of it will be [b]free[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We will never sell new content such as new weapons, abilities, game modes, etc. The only DLCs that will be paid for are supporter packs that add cosmetics and emotes. People can buy these if they want to support us as a studio, but it will never be required to get the latest, coolest stuff we’ve added to the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a brief preview of the updates we’re working on:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Infinite Mode[/b]: lets you continue playing indefinitely until you feel ready to face the final boss, with enemies infinitely scaling. We are excited to see who can make the most broken build and reach the furthest depths![/p][/*][*][p][b]Random Order Mode[/b]: keeps things fresh by switching up the areas so they’re not always in the same order. If you play with Random Order Mode on, you might start in Area 3, then go to Area 1, and so on. It will take some balance work to get it right, but we think this will be appreciated by those who play the game the most.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alternative boss patterns[/b]: new movesets for the bosses, so you never really know which ones you’ll get in your next expedition.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Of course, we’ll also be adding new weapons, weapon mods, abilities, and some more secret stuff we want to keep as a surprise. [/p][p][/p][p]After the 1.1 and 1.2 patches, we will take a step back, listen to community feedback, and figure out what our next updates should be.[/p][p]
We don’t want to reveal everything right now, but we want our players to know that we intend to keep updating Abyssus according to your feedback and to what we think will make the best game in the long run. 

We love this game, and we love working on it. So, if you have any suggestions, feedback, or ideas, please leave a comment below![/p][p][/p][p]We also just released a new hotfix. Read more here : [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1721110/view/523100258247376997"][/dynamiclink]
- The DoubleMoose Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]

notes.title: HOTFIX NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[p] Greetings, Brinehunters!

We just applied a new hotfix to Abyssus, intended to solve some of the issues reported since the launch of the game.
We are still working on your feedback, and we will roll out further fixes as we investigate and take action on the different issues you report.
Please keep in mind that in order to apply the fix, Abyssus must be closed and restarted. Moreover, you won’t be able to join the sessions of players who have not downloaded it yet.

notes.title: NEW HOTFIX LANDING NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Brinehunters! As your feedback flows in, we are hard at work on your reports to make the Abyssus experience as smooth and polished as it can be.
[/p][p]We are currently testing a new hotfix that we'll deploy next week. This latest update will fix some of the issues you reported, and notably:

- Progression blockers and “stuck” scenarios 
- notably during the To’raka fight, the Workbench, or in environmental hazards.[/p][p]- Visual and animation glitches (frozen objectives, incorrect projectile or orb colors, deformed models, missing indicators).[/p][p]- Weapon and mod functionalities that are not working as intended.[/p][p]- Controller navigation and menu accessibility.[/p][p]- Boss and encounters balancing.

We'll publish more details with the full changelog early next week. In the meantime, we want to reiterate our thanks for your feedback, for enjoying Abyssus, and for helping us make it better day after day!

- The DoubleMoose Team[/p][p]

notes.title: UPDATE ON THE SESSION BROWSER ISSUE
notes.content:
[p]We have been looking to solve the current issue causing the game to crash when the Session Browser is accessed in-game, and we have deployed a hotfix that should solve the problem.

Please remember that you will have to close and restart Abyssus to download this hotfix.[/p][p][/p][p]You will still be able to play in solo and with your friends through Steam invites, as it is currently possible, and the Session Browser should no longer crash the game. If you still experience issues with this or any other of the game features, do not hesitate to send us your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]We are sorry for the inconvenience and thank all of you for your support.[/p][p][/p][p] - The DoubleMoose Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ABYSSUS LAUNCHES AUGUST 12 – NEW STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Listen up, Brinehunters!

We know you’ve been itching for adventure, and our first demo wasn’t enough to fill your cravings for iron, steam, and brine. We heard you, and we’re thrilled to reveal that you’ll be able to plunge into the full depths of the Abyss on [b][u]August 12, 2025[/u][/b]!

But be careful. In the deepest fathoms of the sea, now one will hear you scream – so you’d better prepare for your expedition. 
Lucky for you, we’ve cooked you the perfect training program.

[h3]Discover what awaits you in our Release Date Trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=vnAWfATPH3I;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A New Demo Surfaces![/h3]
To be sure you’re prepared for your upcoming dive on August 12, we’ve come up with a brand-new expedition:
Dive into the all-new [b]Gardens[/b] biome, a lush yet haunting domain where aquatic guardians stand ready to defend the ruins of their lost civilization from intruders.

And since the challenges will be tougher than before, we’ve got you covered with a [b]brand-new, electrifying weapon[/b]: the [b][u]Tesla rifle[/u][/b]! Its electric power can be concentrated onto a target or arc among the enemies, delivering devastating bursts of damage to tightly packed enemies. Its true potential is unleashed through secondary mods, enabling powerful charged attacks. 

The Tesla Gun will be joining the arsenal you’re already familiar with:
[list]
[*] [b][u]The Brine Revolver[/u][/b]: A masterfully crafted semi-automatic sidearm designed for reliable critical strikes. Built for precision and power, the primary fire mode excels in close-quarters combat, delivering consistent damage to deal with nearby enemies, while the secondary fire lets you pick off distant foes while aiming down its sight.
[*] [b][u]The Engine Rifle[/u][/b]: A powerhouse of the depths, the Engine Rifle earns its name from its fiery temper. Use your secondary weapon to rev the engine into overdrive, unleashing bursts of raw power while pushing heat levels to the brink.
[*] [b][u]The Shotgun[/u][/b]: A true staple of any FPS arsenal, this juggernaut is built to deliver sheer devastation at close range. Unleash a relentless spread of bullets that tear through guardians with raw stopping power.
[/list]
Gather your crew. It’s time to face the depths of the Abyss one more time.
